name: Named predicate vector
role: concept-bottleneck proxy
notes: Separates local Boolean computation from raw perception grounding

name: GateBeam synthesizer
role: learn compact Boolean expression
notes: Repository implementation/integration; recursive Expr counts formula references and is not a shared-DAG oracle

name: Differentiable gate selector
role: jointly learn variable binding and Boolean operator
input_format: binary predicate vector and task label
output_format: soft finite hypothesis mixture and one hardened gate
replaceable_by: DLGN learned wiring or neural architecture search
notes: Enumerates all two-input pairs and four operators; not unrestricted topology search

name: MCR2 gradient-flow proxy
role: maximize finite-sample log-det rate reduction
notes: Exact analytic NumPy gradient with optional ISTA soft threshold

name: Boolean universal coder
role: assign decodable lengths to binary representations and residual masks
input_format: binary sample matrix and optional side-information labels
notes: Repository implementation of known universal-code components; independent KT and joint finite-alphabet Dirichlet variants expose basis dependence

name: Exact formula catalog
role: prove minimum formula-tree gate count under a fixed basis
input_format: complete truth table up to four inputs
output_format: minimum formula witness and full semantic catalog
notes: Repository implementation of formula DP; AND OR XOR NAND; constants are free sources; NOT costs NAND(x

name: Multi-language MDL router
role: select shortest decodable function or task explanation
input_format: truth table and candidate language family
output_format: language tag plus model and residual code
notes: Repository integration of known MDL ideas; pays route overhead and retains raw-label escape path

name: Basis-aware exact formula oracle
role: measure basis-relative minimum formula size and retained-witness code
output_format: AIG/XAG/MIG-style and MIXED formula witnesses plus diagnostics
notes: Repository implementation; exact formula only; hash-cons DAG and code are retained-witness upper bounds; primitive counts are not PPA

name: External Hard-LGN provenance bridge
role: audit selected hardening and ABC artifacts from another project
output_format: normalized hashes compact summary and selected rows
notes: Audited external evidence rather than a symbolic_logic experiment; task-input equality is not SAT equivalence

name: Bit packer
role: compile repeated predicates to byte lanes
notes: Reports kernel-only and packing-inclusive timing separately

name: Indexed relation filter
role: generate sparse local relation candidates
notes: Separates indexing benefit from Boolean gate cost

name: BFS solver
role: perform global recursive reachability
notes: Used only after local edge validity is determined

name: SoftGateCircuit
role: learn differentiable gate mixtures then harden
output_format: soft probability or hardened Boolean bit
notes: Fixed-wiring controlled proxy; evaluates operator hardening without claiming architecture-search equivalence

name: Learned gate BFS adapter
role: connect learned local edge predicate to symbolic BFS
notes: Measures input-output compatibility for soft and hardened learned gates

name: Looped state-transition engine
role: iterate a frontier/state register to a fixed point
notes: Separates variable-length control from fixed gate unrolling

name: Probability semiring control
role: compare exact WMC soft semiring and hard threshold
notes: Shows independence/decomposability and hardening limits

name: Planning frontier proxy
role: expand a monotone action frontier with fixed or looped control
input_format: Boolean state bits and blocked action
notes: Tests variable-depth search control without claiming a complete planning system

name: Patch MLP encoder
role: ground rendered RGB cell patches into named concepts
notes: Component-supervised neural perception with temperature calibration

name: Learned edge gate
role: combine source and target passability probabilities
output_format: soft edge probability and hardened Boolean edge
notes: Operator mixture learns AND while candidate topology remains fixed four-neighbor adjacency

name: Hybrid reachability adapter
role: route high-confidence samples to hard BFS and low-confidence samples to soft max-product reachability
notes: Validation-tuned fallback policy exposes uncertainty rather than hiding it

name: Synchronous Boolean CA engine
role: reuse one local transition over a finite grid and horizon
input_format: binary grid plus boundary and update policy
notes: Supports 1D and 2D synchronous updates with explicit periodic or fixed boundary semantics

name: Official DiffLogic-CA hard-circuit adapter
role: parse and execute frozen Google DigitalJS artifacts
input_format: official JSON circuit plus binary cell state
output_format: hard recurrent state and output-reachability-audited gate counts
notes: Semantic replay only; fixed learned operators and wiring are not retrained

name: CA task and trajectory coder
role: separate program state control and residual description
input_format: local rule initial state boundary horizon decoder and observed trajectory
notes: Reports both model bits per update and residual bits so repetition alone cannot manufacture compression

name: Boolean wavefront pathfinder
role: propagate reachability through local cell state
notes: Exact monotone local recurrence trades compact update logic for grid state and diameter-dependent iterations
